main_body: Leafy tree canopy (large green mass) on a thin brown trunk with a grass patch at the base
top_band: Canopy top: mid/light greens rows ~1-12 forming a rounded dome with highlight clumps; no flat band, organic mass reads as volume lit from above
evidence: Organic tree: the canopy shows lit upper clumps in lighter greens and darker underside clusters at rows ~26-34 above the trunk, giving dome volume with a top and a shaded front. Trunk is lit on the left and dark on the right, with a grass ellipse at the base. Reads as a 3/4 tree comparable to the references; no receding side faces and not a flat elevation.

style.evidence: Canopy uses about 5 greens in clumps with a dark green outline that leans toward the leaf colour, not black. Leaf clumps are blobbier and less defined than the references, which show distinct per-leaf highlight clusters and branches visible through the foliage. The trunk is a plain two-tone column with little bark grain, and the grass patch is mostly flat. The overall look is close to the references but a bit softer and less rich, so a careful artist would likely accept it, though it sits slightly below them.
